normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter of _transfer and directly feeds its access limits and balance updates
to is a parameter of _transfer and directly feeds its recipient checks and balance updates
amount is a parameter of _transfer and directly feeds its limit checks and fee math
recipient is the parameter of the public transfer function forwarded to _transfer
tokenAmount is the parameter of swapTokensForEth passed to the router swap
_tradingOpen is the parameter of setTrading written to the tradingOpen state variable
maxTxAmount is the parameter of setMaxTxnAmount written to _maxTxAmount
accounts is the parameter of excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees used to update the exemption mapping
swapTokensAtAmount is the parameter of setMinSwapTokensThreshold written to the threshold state variable
takeFee is the local fee flag in _transfer passed into _tokenTransfer
contractTokenBalance is a local in _transfer used to decide the swap amount
canSwap is a local boolean in _transfer that gates the swap call
path is the local swap path array used by swapTokensForEth
currentRate is the local rate value used by tokenFromReflection for the conversion
